entities.name: CoaBC candidate
observations: 399-aa query has 51.6% identity and 98% query coverage to reviewed Mycolicibacterium smegmatis CoaBC (UniProt A0QWT2).
Homology supports a bifunctional role in coenzyme A biosynthesis: phosphopantothenate-cysteine ligase and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activities.
Reviewed homolog annotation reports FMN and Mg2+ cofactors; CoA biosynthesis steps 2 and 3; homododecameric assembly. These are homolog-based predictions for the query, not direct measurements.
Sequence-derived length 399 aa; estimated molecular mass 42.19 kDa and theoretical pI 5.32.
